PROGRAM return review

TYPE ReturnStatus is "new" | "approved" | "needs_review"

RECORD ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: integer

RECORD ReturnDecision
  status: ReturnStatus
  reason: "new" | "within_window" | "outside_window"

REQUEST review return
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision
    IF item.days_since_purchase <= 30
      SET decision.status to "approved"
      SET decision.reason to "within_window"
    ELSE
      SET decision.status to "needs_review"
      SET decision.reason to "outside_window"

  OUTPUT decision is ReturnDecision

  THEN decision.status != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO return on day 30
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 30

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status is "approved"
  AND decision.reason is "within_window"

SCENARIO return on day 31
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 31

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status is "needs_review"
  AND decision.reason is "outside_window"

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision
    IF incident.customer_outage = true
      SET decision.priority to "urgent"
      SET decision.reason to "customer_outage"
    ELSE IF incident.severity = "critical"
      SET decision.priority to "urgent"
      SET decision.reason to "degraded_service"
    ELSE IF incident.severity = "degraded"
      SET decision.priority to "review"
      SET decision.reason to "degraded_service"
    ELSE
      SET decision.priority to "routine"
      SET decision.reason to "normal_operations"

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: true
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "urgent"
  AND decision.reason = "customer_outage"

SCENARIO critical severity is urgent
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "urgent"
  AND decision.reason = "degraded_service"

SCENARIO degraded service needs review
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "degraded"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "review"
  AND decision.reason = "degraded_service"

SCENARIO normal service is routine
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "normal"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "routine"
  AND decision.reason = "normal_operations"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
    IF order.available_units >= order.requested_units
      SET fulfillment.status = "fulfilled"
      SET fulfillment.reserved_units = order.requested_units
      SET fulfillment.backordered_units = 0
    ELSE IF order.available_units > 0
      SET fulfillment.status = "partial"
      SET fulfillment.reserved_units = order.available_units
      SET fulfillment.backordered_units = order.requested_units - order.available_units
    ELSE
      SET fulfillment.status = "backordered"
      SET fulfillment.reserved_units = 0
      SET fulfillment.backordered_units = order.requested_units

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

SCENARIO sufficient stock is fully fulfilled
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 8
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "fulfilled"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 5
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 0

SCENARIO some stock is partially fulfilled
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 3
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "partial"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 3
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 2

SCENARIO no stock is backordered
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 0
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "backordered"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 0
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  IF facts.cohort_funded = false
    SET decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    SET decision.reason = "unfunded_cohort"
  ELSE IF facts.previously_funded = true
    SET decision.outcome = "funded"
    SET decision.reason = "previously_funded"
  ELSE IF facts.institution_eligible = true
    SET decision.outcome = "funded"
    SET decision.reason = "eligible"
  ELSE
    SET decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    SET decision.reason = "ineligible_institution"

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO unfunded cohort takes precedence over all other facts
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: false
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: true
  AND decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason = "unfunded_cohort"

SCENARIO previous funding takes precedence over institution eligibility
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: false
  AND decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
  AND decision.reason = "previously_funded"

SCENARIO eligible institution funds an otherwise new applicant
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: true
  AND decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
  AND decision.reason = "eligible"

SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded after all earlier checks
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: false
  AND decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason = "ineligible_institution"

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  RULE breaking changes are major
    WHEN commit.breaking_change
    THEN release.level = "major"

  RULE features are minor unless breaking
    WHEN commit.feature AND NOT commit.breaking_change
    THEN release.level = "minor"

  RULE fixes are patch unless breaking or feature
    WHEN commit.fix AND NOT commit.breaking_change AND NOT commit.feature
    THEN release.level = "patch"

  RULE irrelevant commits produce no release
    WHEN NOT commit.breaking_change AND NOT commit.feature AND NOT commit.fix
    THEN release.level = "none"

  THEN release.level != "new"

SCENARIO breaking change takes precedence over feature and fix
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: true
    feature: true
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "major"

SCENARIO feature takes precedence over fix
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: true
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "minor"

SCENARIO fix produces a patch release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "patch"

SCENARIO irrelevant commit produces no release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: false
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "none"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval uses the domain behavior
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

WHEN mark known item from <items> into <result>
  FIND item in items WHERE item == "known"
    set result to item
  ELSE
    set result to "missing"

SCENARIO known item is selected
GIVEN items is ["known"]
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "known"

SCENARIO known item is missing
GIVEN items is ["other"]
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "missing"

WHEN record waiting <days> into <total>
  GIVEN days is integer
  AND total is integer
  add days to total

SCENARIO waiting days are counted
GIVEN days is 5
GIVEN total is 0
WHEN record waiting days into total
THEN total == 5

RECORD Applicant
  name: text
  referral: optional<text>

WHEN classify <applicant> into <status>
  GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  IF applicant.referral is present
    IF applicant.referral == "trusted"
      set status to "approved"
    ELSE
      set status to "review"
  ELSE
    set status to "review"

SCENARIO missing referral requires review
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "review"

SCENARIO trusted referral is approved
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
  referral: "trusted"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "approved"

TYPE ReviewState = "new"

RECORD Review
  status: ReviewState

SCENARIO review begins new
GIVEN review is Review
  status: "new"
THEN review.status == "new"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval changes the decision
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: true
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "urgent"
  AND decision.reason = "customer_outage"

SCENARIO critical severity is urgent
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "urgent"
  AND decision.reason = "degraded_service"

SCENARIO degraded service needs review
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "degraded"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "review"
  AND decision.reason = "degraded_service"

SCENARIO normal service is routine
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "normal"
    customer_outage: false
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority = "routine"
  AND decision.reason = "normal_operations"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  IF order.available_units >= order.requested_units
    SET fulfillment.status = "fulfilled"
    SET fulfillment.reserved_units = order.requested_units
    SET fulfillment.backordered_units = 0
  IF order.available_units < order.requested_units AND order.available_units > 0
    SET fulfillment.status = "partial"
    SET fulfillment.reserved_units = order.available_units
    SET fulfillment.backordered_units = order.requested_units - order.available_units
  IF order.available_units == 0
    SET fulfillment.status = "backordered"
    SET fulfillment.reserved_units = 0
    SET fulfillment.backordered_units = order.requested_units

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

SCENARIO sufficient stock is fully fulfilled
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 8
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "fulfilled"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 5
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 0

SCENARIO some stock is partially fulfilled
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 3
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "partial"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 3
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 2

SCENARIO no stock is backordered
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 0
  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0
  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment
  THEN fulfillment.status == "backordered"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 0
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

  SCENARIO unfunded cohort takes precedence over previous funding and eligibility
    GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
      cohort_funded: false
      previously_funded: true
      institution_eligible: true
    AND decision is FundingDecision
      outcome: "new"
      reason: "new"
    WHEN assess facts into decision
    THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    AND decision.reason = "unfunded_cohort"

  SCENARIO previous funding takes precedence over institution ineligibility
    GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
      cohort_funded: true
      previously_funded: true
      institution_eligible: false
    AND decision is FundingDecision
      outcome: "new"
      reason: "new"
    WHEN assess facts into decision
    THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
    AND decision.reason = "previously_funded"

  SCENARIO eligible institution funds a new applicant
    GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
      cohort_funded: true
      previously_funded: false
      institution_eligible: true
    AND decision is FundingDecision
      outcome: "new"
      reason: "new"
    WHEN assess facts into decision
    THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
    AND decision.reason = "eligible"

  SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded after earlier checks
    GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
      cohort_funded: true
      previously_funded: false
      institution_eligible: false
    AND decision is FundingDecision
      outcome: "new"
      reason: "new"
    WHEN assess facts into decision
    THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    AND decision.reason = "ineligible_institution"

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  THEN release.level != "new"

SCENARIO breaking changes are major even with feature and fix
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: true
    feature: true
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "major"

SCENARIO features are minor even with a fix
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: true
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "minor"

SCENARIO fixes are patch
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: true
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "patch"

SCENARIO irrelevant commits produce no release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: false
  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level = "none"

ENUM ReviewState
  "new"

RECORD Review
  status: ReviewState

SCENARIO review begins new
GIVEN review is Review
  status: "new"
THEN review.status == "new"
